name: SuperTokens
description: SuperTokens is an open-source authentication service and alternative to Auth0, Firebase Auth and Cognito. It handles sessions, email/password, passwordless, social login and multi-factor authentication, while your own backend talks to it through the SuperTokens SDKs.

notes.text: There is no web UI: point your backend SDK at http://<IP>:3567 and use the API key from /opt/supertokens_data/.env.
Keep port 3567 reachable only from your backend, never from browsers or the internet.

app_vars.name: var_api_key
app_vars.label: API Key
app_vars.help: At least 20 characters of letters, digits, = and -. Generated when left empty
